title: Delta and NVIDIA partner on Level 4 autonomous driving
source_used: Ad Hoc News (relaying a Delta Electronics release)
key_facts: Delta Electronics, listed in Taiwan, has a collaboration with NVIDIA on Level 4 autonomous driving systems.
Delta contributes automotive energy management, electric powertrain, in-vehicle computing and system integration.
The work uses NVIDIA Hyperion and the NVIDIA Halos safety system.
Per Delta’s release of 29 Sep 2026; Automotive World reported it the same day.
quote_evidence: Delta’s latest strategic development is its collaboration with NVIDIA on Level 4 autonomous driving systems.

The company combines automotive energy management, xEV powertrain systems, in-vehicle computing and system integration with NVIDIA Hyperion and the NVIDIA Halos safety system, according to Delta Electronics in its September 29, 2026 release.
why_it_matters_hint: Delta joins Nvidia’s self-driving platform, but no vehicle or launch date is named.
